chunks: ʿUthmān ibn ʿĪsā narrated from Samāʿah, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about the fingers: whether some of them have superiority over others in the blood money. He said: “They are equal in the blood money.”

key_terms.ٱلدِّيَةِ: blood money; prescribed financial compensation for bodily injury

ai.seo_question: Are some fingers worth more than others in diyah according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding diyah for fingers. It states that all fingers are treated equally in blood money, with no distinction in value between some and others.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5295 - It is narrated by Uthman ibn Isa from Sama'ah from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) who said:

I asked Imam (as) about the fingers - whether some of them have more value over others in terms of blood money (diyyah).
Imam (as) replied: "They are all equal in blood money (diyyah)."
